label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McDowell on LIV Challenges
items.text: Graeme McDowell says LIV Golf faces "headwinds" post-2026 and plans to return to the DP World Tour in 2027 with settled fines and ongoing talks.

items.headline: Minjee Lee Withdraws
items.text: Three-time major leader Minjee Lee withdrew midway through the second round of the Women's Scottish Open due to injury, casting doubt on her AIG Women’s British Open status.

items.headline: DeChambeau Eyes Irish Open
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau expressed interest in playing the Irish Open at Trump International Doonbeg if it fits his schedule, following Rory McIlroy's public welcome despite their tensions.
